verdict.rationale: Source availability under an open license is a fair question for any software product, so the axis applies. The pack shows no evidence that Sales Cloud's own source is published or openly licensed. The only GitHub items cover the separate Salesforce CLI and MCP repos, and even those carry no license information, so they are adjacent tooling rather than the product's source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
